holder-quote: Hedag laughed merrily. Without further ado, she reached out and grasped Elmmet’s head in the pillory. The man shouted, but Hedag held him for only a second. She bellowed across the crowd.
effect-quote: Then she pulled something out of Elmmet. Prost recoiled as Hedag yanked out something black, a shadowy thing, and hurled it on the ground.

holder-quote: It was the Halfling whom the Hedag spoke to.
effect-quote: A list that detailed every single life he had ever taken
